title: The lamp of the body is the eye
english: [[The lamp of the body is the eye >> Bible:Matthew 6:22]]. If your eye is single, the whole body is full of light; if evil, the whole body is dark — and if the light in you is darkness, how great is that darkness. A single eye is unfeigned love, by which the body is lit when outer parts match what is thought within; the evil eye is pretended love, also called hypocrisy, through which the whole body is darkened — dark deeds conceived inside, while the outer members put forward words that seem to be light.

title: Wolves in sheep’s clothing; cup and dish
english: They are truly [[wolves in sheep’s clothing >> Bible:Matthew 7:15]] — washing only the outside of cup and dish, not knowing that unless the inside is cleansed the outside cannot be clean.

title: If the light in you is darkness
english: So the Savior exposes them: [[If the light in you is darkness, how great is the darkness >> Bible:Matthew 6:23]] — that is, if what seems to you to be love-as-light is, through hidden hypocrisy, a work worthy of darkness…
